prompt_text: Create a transparent-background pixel-art six-view atlas for the two exact Larracos masonry corner components, using the first two reference sprites as the sole identity, orientation, cap-count, palette, and material authority. Output exactly 6 columns by 2 rows, no labels, no ground or cast shadows. Columns left-to-right are FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR; row 1 is the OUTER corner source, row 2 the INNER corner source. Every view must depict the same physical L-shaped corner with the source's exact three gold-knob square caps (the joined corner plus the two open arm ends), not a filled square and not a fourth cap. TOP must preserve the exact native L-shaped teal-and-stone wall arms and the three cap locations. BOTTOM is the same full L footprint from below with opaque inferred stone/teal support undersides; the upper knobs are occluded and only their base footprints may show. FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR are true flat orthographic elevations: broad rectangular level-height masonry faces where the wall arm faces the camera, narrow end faces where an arm points toward the camera, with shared height/groundline and source teal stone, pale masonry, coral vine accents and dark outline. The outer and inner plans have different L orientation; preserve each source's own hand and exact arm placement in every view. Do not turn any view into an oblique two-face corner, do not add repeated gold face badges, arches, banners, scenery, or ornaments. Crisp source-matched game pixel art.
